description.narrative: Radikal Ungdom (RU) will visit Baku, Azerbaijan, to meet with the American-Azerbaijani-Social-Association (AAYSA) as a potential partner. Both organisations share a commitment to youth engagement, advocacy, and promoting democratic confidence, particularly focusing on women's rights and gender equality. AAYSA initiated contact with RU, inspired by the leadership of Maria Georgi, and expressed interest in learning about youth engagement in Denmark. The trip aims to explore partnership opportunities and through these interactions, both organisations can assess compatibility, identify common interests, and develop a shared vision for partnership activities. Ultimately, the trip aims to lay the groundwork for a productive and mutually beneficial collaboration between Radikal Ungdom and its potential partner American-Azerbaijan-Social-Association
